name: Should I stack my washer and dryer or keep them side by side?

mainEntity.name: Should I stack my washer and dryer or keep them side by side?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Stacked units save floor area, while side-by-side machines simplify loading, provide a folding surface, and may be easier to service. The better choice depends on household capacity, appliance dimensions, ceiling height, accessibility, and the amount of counter space desired.

Elite Remodeling & Design can compare both arrangements during layout development and account for door swings, hookups, ventilation, storage, and future replacement. A narrow room may benefit from stacking, but the chosen unit must be practical for everyone using it.

Key factors:
- Reach and lifting comfort.
- Clearance for doors and controls.
- Available folding and hanging space.
- Replacement options if one appliance fails.

Bring preferred appliance models before cabinetry is designed. Do not assume every stacked set has identical dimensions or connection requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stacking saves floor space, while side-by-side machines usually offer easier loading, simpler service, and room for a folding counter. Compare appliance dimensions, user comfort, ceiling height, storage needs, and future replacement plans.
